newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via 3-day fixed system repo's.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via 3-day fixed system repo's.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added temporary reserves to the open market on Monday through three-day system repurchase agreements, a Fed spokeswoman confirmed.
Money market analysts had expected such an operation, citing a need for reserves as two-week bank reserve maintenance period ends on Wednesday.
Federal funds were trading at 5-1/4 percent, the Fed's target for the rate, at the time of the operation.
(( -- E. Freilich, North American Treasury Desk, 212-859-1679))
